title: Mochizuki Honami — Unseen Feelings〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: One day, during lunch
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Excuse me.
My name is Honami Mochizuki and I'm here for the cleanup committee meeting.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Honami!
I've been looking forward to seeing you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello, Shizuku.
I've been looking forward to today as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
I heard that band practice has been a little tough lately.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii's been coming home so late even when she doesn't have to go to work.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry for keeping her out so late...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho works with each of us during practice and it takes away from her own time too. She ends up having to wait until later to work on her own part...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, don't mind that. I'm sorry for not choosing my words better...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know that Shii's a hard-working girl, so it's not surprising that she's doing that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I also know that resting is just as important as practicing, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Shizuku...
Thank you for being so considerate of us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right about needing to rest. We'll make sure not to overdo things.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We've been thinking about performing in our own show, so that might've gotten us a little worked up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
A show?
Oh, that's why you've been working so hard!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
When will it be? And where?
I'll definitely come and see it!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, but we still don't know yet...
I promise to tell you when we do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm worried about what's going to happen. I always get so nervous in those situations...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh? Weren't you in the junior high brass band, Honami? I thought you'd be used to performing in front of others by now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, I do have some experience but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The drummer is like the musical foundation that supports the entire band according to Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If I don't play well, I may end up bringing everyone else down with me, and the audience won't know how hard we worked to get on stage.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I need to build up my confidence and make sure that I can do my best.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I see...
I didn't know just how important the drums are...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes...
There's something else that's been bothering me as well...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is it about Shii...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, yes...!
Um, she hasn't been herself lately...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika's under the impression that we're just not at her level yet and she's actually been practicing on her own.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I'm wondering if that's really the whole story. I feel like we don't have the entire picture yet...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii hasn't been able to tell you yet...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, it's nothing! Ignore that last part!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'm sure working with Shii is no easy task either, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes, she's very hard on us...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But that's also the reason that I've gotten better and I understand what she's trying to do with us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That's why I feel like we need to do everything we can to make sure her efforts don't go to waste.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And for Saki's sake too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She's out of the hospital and her life is finally back to normal, so she wants to make up for all the time she lost.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Our band is a part of her memories. I want to cherish it as much as possible!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You're such good girls...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Honami, would it be alright if I asked something of you...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, of course...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Please... Look after Shii...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Is this about her taking on more than she can handle...?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... Yes, I will. I'll do what I can!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you very much.
